scope: 30 newly recognized components (14 Abilities, 10 attacks, 6 Trainers), 19 fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Thick Scale
sources.checkedFacts: A Dragon host takes 50 less attack damage from opposing Grass, Fire, Water or Lightning Pokemon after Weakness and Resistance.

sources.title: Dewgong, Thick Fat
sources.checkedFacts: Reduces attack damage from opposing Fire or Water Pokemon by 30.

sources.title: Terapagos ex, Crown Opal
sources.checkedFacts: During the next opponent turn, blocks damage from Basic non-Colorless Pokemon. Attack effects remain effective.

sources.title: Fairy Charm Psychic
sources.checkedFacts: A Fairy host is protected from attack damage of opposing Psychic GX and legacy EX Pokemon.

boundaries: Actual current top Pokemon type is independent from attack damage type and attached Energy. Combat profile fallback applies only when printed type tags are absent.
Included types use OR; excluded types reject any matching type, including dual-type Pokemon. Unknown or malformed types are rejected.
Source type requirements combine with Basic or GX/legacy EX requirements; Tool host conditions and suppression remain enforced.
Temporary protection expires at the specified opponent turn end. Damage-only protection does not stop counters or status effects.
Passive mappings require explicit opposing attacks. Broader own-attack wording is not mapped.
No prior supported program changes, downgrades or card metadata changes.
